title: Slash AI Costs: Master Claude & Codex Subscriptions! #shorts
description:
Thinking about your AI tool costs?

Here's a smart way to manage your subscriptions:

• Downgraded Claude to Max 5X ($100/month).
• Running Codex as the main thread ($100/month).

Why? Codex offers more usage than a $200 Claude plan right now. If Claude limits hit, I'll re-upgrade. This setup helps me stay within budget without losing power.
